command_line:
set -eu
cat > map_ids.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(org.Mm.eg.db))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(AnnotationDbi))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
ids <- readLines(args[1], warn=FALSE)
ids <- ids[nzchar(ids)]
map <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Mm.eg.db, keys=ids, keytype='ENSEMBL', columns=c('SYMBOL'))
map <- map[!is.na(map$SYMBOL) & nzchar(map$SYMBOL), , drop=FALSE]
ord <- match(map$ENSEMBL, ids)
map <- map[order(ord), , drop=FALSE]
symbols <- unique(map$SYMBOL)
writeLines(symbols, con='sig_symbols.txt')
write.table(map, file='id_mapping.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na='NA')
summary <- data.frame(metric=c('input_ensembl','mapped_rows','unique_symbols'), value=c(length(ids), nrow(map), length(symbols)))
write.table(summary, file='mapping_summary.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
RSCRIPT
